claims.statement: The slot correction was applied to the wrong carrier feed and did not resolve the stuck orders
claims.corroboration: Observability verified that the correction ran before the feed lag was confirmed and targeted the wrong feed; no change in held orders
claims.limitation: Indicates the mitigation was premature; the specific affected carrier feed was not identified before the correction was applied

claims.statement: The specific carrier feed to which orders in scope EXC-0921 were routed must be identified and verified for lag before applying slot corrections
claims.corroboration: Carrier Ops precondition: corrections must run 'only after the affected feed and its lag are identified'
claims.limitation: This is a procedural requirement, not yet a confirmed finding

capability_gaps.reason: Must identify the specific carrier feed to which the EXC-0921 orders were routed (e.g., 'FedEx east', 'UPS-2', etc.) before attempting another slot correction

next_action.rationale: The slot correction failed because it targeted the wrong feed. Before reapplying the mitigation, must trace the actual carrier feed assignment for orders in scope EXC-0921. This will identify which feed is actually lagged and needs correction.
next_action.expected_information_gain: Determines which specific carrier feed the EXC-0921 orders were routed to, enabling targeted and successful slot correction on the correct feed.
